items.name: Monday Night in Gdańsk 2025

venue.name: Hampton by Hilton Gdansk Old Town

items.information:
Monday Night in Gdansk is a small side events competition brought to you by CubikoNH and the Polish Speedcubing community. We hope you have a great time. Be sure to sign up once registration opens as we expect to sell out within a few minutes. Note that this competition does NOT have beginner events such as 3x3x3, 2x2x2, or Pyraminx.

items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTEwMTc3LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--ac5792621809cd6bf8ae73674e3215c45ab7a570/Michigan%20Mini%2036%20Comp%20Page.png)

**This competition takes place on a Monday night!**

Join us for another one of our popular mini competitions!  Both newcomers and experienced competitors are welcome, register quickly to reserve your spot!

Free parking is available on site.
